name: Distribution pole
summary: 45 ft class 3 wood distribution pole with a three-phase crossarm, pin insulators, neutral, 25 kVA transformer, three cutouts, an arrester and a guy wire.
parts: tapered treated pine pole with checks

style: in-service pole, sun-greyed wood, creosote dark near grade
notes: Pole base at the origin; the down guy anchor extends 3 m toward -X, so bounds are off center by design.
